---
title: "Architecture"
---

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  S[Source] --> P[Passage]
  P --> O[Observation]
  O --> E[Event model]
  E --> H[Attribution hypotheses]
  H --> A[Argument graph]
  A --> F[Finding]
  F --> R[Human review]
  R --> X[Publication / scoped export]
```

Canonical records are human-edited JSON. Node.js validates and generates
indexes. Python supports comparative analysis. Quarto publishes selected,
reviewed derivatives. External exports require a separately scoped issue.
